notes:
V3.1.1 — Bot Market UI polish.

The ⊕ BOT MARKET tab grows four new sections so the backend's V3.1.0 metadata is finally visible to the user:

• MY PUBLISHED BOTS — shows your own bots with their download count + total. Hidden state shows a 'haven't published anything' nudge.
• ⭐ FEATURED — top-5 bots flagged by an admin via PUT /admin/bots/{slug}/classify.
• ✦ RECOMMENDED FOR YOU — top-5 recommended.
• BROWSE ALL BOTS — now has filter row: Philosophy dropdown (long/short/day/options/momentum/mean-reversion/scalping/swing), Sort dropdown (downloads / rating / win rate / newest / cheapest), Max credits spin, Min win % spin. Auto-refresh on any filter change.

Every row now shows: name + ⭐ FEATURED / ✦ RECO badges + price (◊ N credits or FREE in green) + description + philosophy + win rate + rating + active users + download count + ⬇ Install. MY BOTS rows show 📊 download count instead of an install button.

Publishing flow gains two more prompts: 'Philosophy' (dropdown) and 'Price in APEX credits'. Server's POST /bots accepts the new fields.

All sections auto-load when you open the tab (no more 'Click Search to load').
